high_level_description: The image depicts a lecture hall or classroom setting where a presentation is taking place. The room is filled with students seated in rows of black chairs, facing the front where two individuals are standing at podiums. The person on the left appears to be a male, dressed in a dark shirt and light-colored pants, while the person on the right seems to be a female, wearing a dark top. The front of the room features two large projection screens displaying a "Thank You" slide with a group photo of attendees and logos from various companies such as Google, AWS, and others.
